title: US Senator Warren voices concern over Nvidia's acquisition of Slurm
title_zh: 美国参议员沃伦对英伟达收购 Slurm 表示担忧
summary: U.S. Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren sent a letter to the U.S. secretaries of the Department of Energy and Department of Defense on Tuesday, questioning them about Nvidia's acquisition ‌of SchedMD, which makes Slurm software.
summary_zh: 美国民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 周二致信美国能源部和国防部长，询问他们有关 Nvidia 收购 Slurm 软件制造商 SchedMD 的情况。

title: Morning Brief: We're watching for S&P 500 record highs again
title_zh: 早间简报：我们期待标普 500 指数再次创下历史新高
summary: Big Bank earnings continue with Bank of America and Morgan Stanley, and we'll be watching for other inklings of consumer and corporate strain throughout.
summary_zh: 美国银行和摩根士丹利继续公布大型银行的财报，我们将全程关注消费者和企业压力的其他迹象。

title: Why this earnings season can change the software narrative
title_zh: 为什么这个财报季可以改变软件的叙述
summary: TECHnalysis Research, LLC, president Bob O'Donnell, joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss how software stocks can change their image this earnings season following the effect of the SAASpocalypse.
summary_zh: TECHnaanalysis Research, LLC 总裁 Bob O'Donnell 与 Josh Lipton 一起在《Market Domination Overtime》节目中讨论软件股如何在 SAASpocalypse 的影响下改变本财报季的形象。

title: Trump Hints at War’s End as Hormuz Standoff Chokes Oil Flows
title_zh: 霍尔木兹对峙阻碍石油供应，特朗普暗示战争结束
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US President Donald Trump played down the prospect of renewed fighting in the war with Iran, even as questions remain over Tehran’s nuclear program and access to the Strait of Hormuz.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了与伊朗重新开战的可能性，尽管德黑兰的核计划和霍尔木兹海峡的出入问题仍然存在。

title_zh: Meta 扩展博通协议，为其应用程序提供人工智能支持

title: Korean AI chip startup DEEPX, Hyundai work on robots powered by generative AI
title_zh: 韩国人工智能芯片初创公司 DEEPX 和现代汽车致力于开发由生成式人工智能驱动的机器人
summary: South Korean AI chip startup DEEPX will expand its partnership with Hyundai Motor Group to develop a computing platform for generative ‌AI robots using its second generation of low-power chips, its top executive said, as ‌it gets set for an IPO.
summary_zh: 韩国人工智能芯片初创公司 DEEPX 将扩大与现代汽车集团的合作伙伴关系，利用其第二代低功耗芯片为生成型人工智能机器人开发计算平台，该公司高管表示，该公司正准备进行 IPO。

title: Amazon’s $11.6 Billion Globalstar Deal Amps Up Musk Rivalry
title_zh: 亚马逊 116 亿美元的 Globalstar 交易加剧了马斯克的竞争
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc.’s $11.6 billion deal to buy Globalstar Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚马逊公司 (Amazon.com Inc.) 以 116 亿美元收购 Globalstar Inc.

title: Bessent Calls Anthropic’s Mythos a Breakthrough in China AI Race
title_zh: Bessent 称 Anthropic 的神话是中国人工智能竞赛的突破
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hailed Anthropic PBC’s Mythos as a revolutionary step that will keep America ahead of China in AI, endorsing an industry leader that’s clashed with Washington over its role in military endeavors.Bessent, speaking Tuesday at a ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 称赞 Anthropic PBC 的 Mythos 是革命性的一步，它将让美国在人工智能领域领先于中国，并支持一位在军事行动中与华盛顿发生冲突的行业领导者。贝森特周二在一次会议上发表讲话。
